title: Meeting in the middle — wave interference
description: Two waves. One sum. Move their phase and watch reinforcement turn into cancellation.

title: Spider — drive the open country
description: Drive the Spider, a raised six-wheeled scout carrier with hydropneumatic legs, across a generated watershed of rivers, gullies, cliffs, forests and cornfields, or set it down at a lunar crater base, on the lava plains under the Olympus Mons scarp, or on Titan's dune shoreline by a methane lake. Free roam or fly wildfire, swiftwater rescue, forward pursuit and hostile crossing missions.

title: Switchbox
description: A girl lives in a pink toy box with six lamped switches and pushes every one you flip back down. Find the hidden order that lights all six.
